inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The urinal in the boys restroom was not functional.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible: Child was found sound asleep in a restrictive device.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant May Not Sleep in a Restrictive Device - Remove the infant from the device and place the infant in a crib as soon as possible (26 TAC §746.2426(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages: Caregiver in the infant room was not able to respond to qestions about the age range of children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know children's names and ages (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Adequate Lighting During Naptime: Infant room was not properly lit upon entering.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Adequate Lighting During Naptime (26 TAC §746.2911)

occurrences.finding: Report Number of Employees: The operation has not reported to CCR the number of employees who ceased working at the center in 2024 within the required timeframe.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Report Number of Employees (26 TAC §746.303(b))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Not Over Concrete or Asphalt: Play equipment was observed on the outdoor play area with rubber pieces for loose fill material that is installed over concrete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Not Over Concrete or Asphalt (26 TAC §746.4907(b))

occurrences.finding: Block certification training include hours and topics: Training certificates for the director do not indicate the specific dates of when each training topic was covered.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Block certification training include hours and topics (26 TAC §746.1319(b))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: A caregiver did not have a child wash their hands after diaper changing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Current Driver's License: The daycare driver's driver's license has expired. The provider did not have documentation showing a current driver's license was on file during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records - Photo Identification (26 TAC §746.901(9))

occurrences.finding: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident: Car seats in the van have expired and state not to use them after 2018 and 2020.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child Passenger Safety Seat System - Not expired or damaged in accident (26 TAC §746.5607(b))

occurrences.finding: Training Criteria - Training for employees of child care center only: The center director has provided training to staff when the center has been assesed an administrative penalty within the previous 2 years.
occurrences.violation_type_title: An administrative penalty not assessed against your center during previous two years while your director was serving in that role (26 TAC §746.1317(a)(6)(C))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child: A caregiver did not wash their hands after changing a diaper during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing After Diapering a Child (26 TAC §746.3415(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was observed alone with 6 children in a classroom and had direct access to the children. The caregivers background check is inactive and the operation has not received an eliglibty notification from CBCU stating the caregiver can be present.    Note: The caregiver left the operation during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: A child in care did not have a complete file available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting): The use zone for a merry go cycle did not extend 6 feet. An additional 3 feet is required.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Measurement of Use Zone for Rotating and Rocking Equipment (Sitting) (26 TAC §746.4813(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: A caregiver was observed grabbing a child during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 out of 4 children's files evaluated was missing an   immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records: 1 employee's file was not available for review upon request.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records (26 TAC §746.901)

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: 2 pedals on the Merry-Go-Cycle were missing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Admission Information: The following children's records evaluated were missing the information listed below:    1 out of 8 children's records evaluated did not have an field trip authorization.     1 out of 8 children's records evaluated did not have an water activities authorization.    1 out of 8 children's records evaluated did not have an address for the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Admission Information (26 TAC §746.603(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Physician Information: 3 out of 8 children's records evaluated did not have the name and address of the emergency-care facility.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Physician Information (26 TAC §746.605(11))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: 1 out of 8 children's records evaluated did not have a immunization record.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Not Over Concrete or Asphalt: Loose-fill material was observed installed over concrete.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Not Over Concrete or Asphalt (26 TAC §746.4907(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement: 6 out of 8 children's records evaluated did not have a special care needs statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Special Needs Statement (26 TAC §746.605(13))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling: Caregivers were observed grabbing children by the arm to get them to sit down during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Grabbing and Pulling (26 TAC §746.2805(3))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the inspection children were observed climbing on chairs and tables. One child ran down the hall way into another classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: During the follow up inspection another child was observed sitting in a high chair. It was stated by a caregiver that the child was in the high chair because they were running around and taking a long time to eat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out: During the inspection a child was observed sitting in a high chair while playing on a tablet. When a caregiver was asked why the child was in the highchair it was stated because the child was special needs and would not stop running around.     Note: It was discussed that no child can be confined to any type of restrictive device as a for of discipline.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Restrictive device for time out (26 TAC §746.2805(8))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times: A child was observed during snap time using a tablet.     Note: This was discussed with the provider during the inspecdtion that screen time cannot be used during meals, snacks or naptime. It was suggested that tablets only be used during planned activities.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used During Eating or Rest Times (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(4))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: Another child was observed sitting in a high chair and the safety straps were not secured.     Note: The provider secured the straps during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: During the inspection a caregiver was observed in the infant classroom with direct access to children. The operation has not received an elgiblity notification from CBCU stating the caregiver was allowed to be present.    Note: The caregiver left the operation during the inspection and another qualified caregiver was moved nto the infant room.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: Children were observed climbing on top of chairs and running around the classroom during the inspection. A child also walked out of the classroom and the caregiver closed the classroom door. When opening the classroom door the child was observed walking back from to the classroom with no supervision.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries: Based on the information obtained, there is sufficient evidence to support parents are not informed of less serious injuries at pick up time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Parental Notification of Less Serious Injuries (26 TAC §746.307(c))

occurrences.finding: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games: Based upon the information obtained, there is sufficient evidence to support caregivers are using cell phones while caring for children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Personal use of electronic devices, such as cell phones, MP3 players, tablets, and video games (26 TAC §746.1203(3)(D))

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Signed: Based upon the information obtained, there is sufficient evidence to support a staff person from the operation did not sign the incident report for a child that was injured while in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Signed (26 TAC §746.705)

occurrences.finding: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent: Based upon the information obtained, there is sufficient evidence to support that the incident report for a child who was injured was not shared with the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Incident/Illness Report Form Shared with Parent (26 TAC §746.707)

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: A 22 month old child was observed having screen time. This was corrected during the inspection when the caregiver was observed turning off the television and giving the child another activity to do.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions: A caregiver with conditions on background was observed caring for a group of children alone in the classroom. This was corrected during inspection when another caregiver arrived to work in the classroom with the caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background ck determination - If provisionally eligible w/conditions or eligible w/conditions you must restrict duties per conditions/restrictions (26 TAC §745.635(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily: The playground was observed having hazards( trash) throughout the playground accessible to children as they play. This was corrected during inspection when the caregiver was observed removiing the trash from the playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Inspect Daily (26 TAC §746.4751(a))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Caregiver was observed not washing toddler hands after changing diaper. This was corrected during inspection when the caregiver was observed washing the child's hands.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))

occurrences.finding: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler: Sippy cups iin the toddler room were observed not properly labeled with the child's first name and first initial of last name. This was corrected during inspection when the caregiver was observed properly labeling the sippy cups.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Furnishings and Equipment for Toddlers - Bottles & Training Cups Labeled for Each Toddler (26 TAC §746.2505(4)(A))

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions: The safety alarm in the  transportation vehicle was observed not properly working during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - installed and maintained according to manufacturer's instructions (26 TAC §746.5625(b))

occurrences.finding: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving: An employee no longer associated with the operation had not been inactivated within the required time frame.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Background Check Validation - You must inactivate a subject who is no longer associated with your operation within 7 days of leaving (26 TAC §745.651(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers- Supervision of Children: The caregiver in charge of a group of children did not intervene when the children were utilizing a stack of sleeping equipment as a form of an activity. The caregiver did not intervene when the children fell from the jumping off the stack of sleeping equipment, subsequently obtaining an injury. The caregiver did not intervene appropriately when the children fell off the stack of sleeping equipment.  The children walked towards the caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Supervision of Children (26 TAC §746.1203(4))

occurrences.finding: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs: The caregiver did not provide activities for the children in care.  The children were utilizing the stack of sleeping equipment as a form of play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Planned Activities Designed to Meet Individual Needs (26 TAC §746.2201(a))

occurrences.finding: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Redirecting Behavior: Based on the investigation and information obtained the operation is not in compliance.     Note: The caregiver is no longer employed at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Positive Methods of Discipline and Guidance - Redirecting Behavior (26 TAC §746.2803(4)(C))
